sect3.title: Core
sect3.simpara: In case of a hard OOM (out of memory) condition, PHP now calls abort() instead of exit(1), changing the exit code to 134 and possibly creating a core dump.
The PHP_OS_FAMILY constant has an AIX value for when running on AIX or IBM i via PASE.

sect3.title: CLI
sect3.simpara: The built-in development server now accepts requests using the HTTP QUERY method instead of returning 501 Not Implemented.
The built-in development server no longer reflects the Host header from requests.

sect3.title: Core
sect3.simpara: header_register_callback now declares true as its return type. It has not been able to return &false; since PHP 8.0.0, when passing an invalid callback started throwing a TypeError instead.

register_tick_function now declares true as its return type. It has always returned &true; on success; an invalid callback throws a TypeError during argument parsing before the function body is reached.

ini_get_all now includes a "builtin_default_value" element for each directive when details is &true;. It holds the built-in default value of the directive (or &null; if it has none), independent of values set in &php.ini;, on the command line, or at runtime.
fclose, file_put_contents and copy now return &false; when flushing or closing the stream fails. Previously such failures were silently ignored.

sect3.title: Date
sect3.para:
The following methods now have tentative static return types:
DateTime::createFromInterface DateTimeImmutable::__set_state DateTimeImmutable::modify DateTimeImmutable::add DateTimeImmutable::sub DateTimeImmutable::setTimezone DateTimeImmutable::setTime DateTimeImmutable::setDate DateTimeImmutable::setISODate DateTimeImmutable::setTimestamp DateTimeImmutable::createFromInterface DateTimeZone::__set_state DateInterval::__set_state DatePeriod::__set_state

sect3.title: Filter
sect3.simpara: The return type of filter_var_array has been narrowed from arrayfalsenull to arrayfalse. The function always establishes an array before filtering, so &null; was never returned. filter_input_array is unaffected: it still returns &null; when the requested superglobal does not exist.

sect3.title: LDAP
sect3.simpara: The return type of ldap_free_result has been narrowed from bool to true. The function already always returned &true;.

sect3.title: MySQLi
sect3.simpara: The return structure of mysqli_get_charset no longer contains the undocumented "comment" element. The value of "charsetnr" is now set to a constant 0 as this number was an implementation detail that should not have been exposed to the public.

sect3.title: OpenSSL
sect3.simpara: The output of openssl_x509_parse now contains a "criticalExtensions" entry listing all critical certificate extensions.

openssl_sign and openssl_verify now have an additional optional salt_length argument that allows controlling the RSA-PSS salt length when OPENSSL_PKCS1_PSS_PADDING is used. It accepts an explicit length or one of the new OPENSSL_RSA_PSS_SALTLEN_* constants.

sect3.title: PDO_DBLIB
sect3.simpara: When using persistent connections, there is now a liveness check in PDO::__construct.

sect3.title: Phar
sect3.simpara: Phar::mungServer now supports reference values.

sect3.title: Readline
sect3.simpara: readline_completion_function now declares true as its return type. It has always returned &true; on success; an invalid callback throws a TypeError during argument parsing before the function body is reached.

sect3.title: Reflection
sect3.simpara: The outputs of ReflectionClassConstant::__toString and ReflectionConstant::__toString now print bool constant values as true and false rather than 1 and an empty string. This also affects other ways of printing class constants, e.g. ReflectionClass::__toString.

sect3.title: Sockets
sect3.simpara: socket_addrinfo_lookup now has an additional optional error_code argument that, when not &null;, receives the error code on failure (one of the EAI_* constants).
The return type of socket_cmsg_space has been narrowed from intnull to int. Every failure path has thrown a ValueError since PHP 8.0.0, so &null; was never returned.

sect3.title: Zip
sect3.simpara: The return type of zip_entry_close has been narrowed from bool to true. The function already always returned &true;.

sect3.title: Fileinfo
sect3.simpara: Upgraded to file 5.48. Custom compiled magic databases from older file versions must be regenerated.

sect3.title: Hash
sect3.simpara: The bundled version of xxHash was upgraded to 0.8.2.

sect3.title: MySQLi
sect3.simpara: Added the new constant MYSQLI_OPT_COMPRESS.

sect3.title: Opcache
sect3.simpara: JIT is now supported for ZTS builds on Apple Silicon.

sect3.title: Core
sect3.simpara: The error_include_args INI option has been added to make the display of function arguments consistent in errors; it is off by default. Previously, whether a function showed a parameter in the error was up to each call to the internal error function. Now, all parameters as they were actually passed to the function will be displayed. This uses the same infrastructure as stack traces, so sensitive parameters will not be displayed, and strings will be truncated according to zend.exception_string_param_max_len.

sect3.title: MBString
sect3.simpara: The mbstring.detect_order INI directive now updates the internal detection order when changed at runtime via ini_set. Previously, runtime changes using ini_set did not take effect for mb_detect_order. Setting the directive to &null; or an empty string at runtime now leaves the previously configured detection order unchanged.

sect3.title: MySQLi
sect3.simpara: mysqli.default_port now checks the validity of the value, which should be between 0 and 65535 inclusive.

sect3.title: Opcache
sect3.simpara: opcache.jit_debug accepts a new flag: ZEND_JIT_DEBUG_TRACE_EXIT_INFO_SRC. When used along with ZEND_JIT_DEBUG_TRACE_EXIT_INFO, the source of exit points is printed in the exit info output, in debug builds.

sect3.title: Core
sect3.simpara: printf using only %s and %d will be compiled into the equivalent string interpolation, avoiding the overhead of a function call and repeatedly parsing the format string.
Arguments are now passed more efficiently to known constructors (e.g. when using new self()).

array_map using a first-class callable or partial function application callback will be compiled into the equivalent foreach loop, avoiding the creation of intermediate Closures, the overhead of calling userland callbacks from internal functions and providing for better insight for the JIT.
The performance of the TAILCALL VM has been improved, and it is now enabled on Windows when compiling with Clang 19 or later on x86_64.
The performance of ZTS builds has been improved.
Added a stateless closure cache.
Deeply recursive code that causes the VM to allocate new stack pages should now be faster.
Improved performance of sorting single-element arrays.
sect3.para:
Improved performance of the following functions:
addcslashes, when generating octal escapes array_fill_keys array_intersect array_map, with multiple arrays passed array_product and array_sum, for integer-only arrays array_unshift array_walk intval, for intval('0b...', 2) and intval('+0b...', 2) pathinfo, when requesting a single component str_pad str_repeat, when the multiplier is 1 str_split

sect3.title: DOM
sect3.simpara: Made DOMText::splitText and Dom\Text::splitText faster and consume less memory.

sect3.title: GD
sect3.simpara: imagebmp, imagewbmp, imagegd, and imagegd2 now buffer output when writing to PHP streams, significantly improving performance when writing images to files.
Improved performance of imagegrabscreen and imagegrabwindow on Windows.

sect3.title: Intl
sect3.simpara: Improved performance of IntlCalendar::getAvailableLocales and IntlDateFormatter::localtime/datefmt_localtime by pre-allocating their returned arrays.
Improved performance of transliterator_list_ids and resourcebundle_locales by pre-allocating their returned arrays.
Optimized callback invocation in IntlChar::enumCharTypes.

sect3.title: JSON
sect3.simpara: Improved performance of encoding arrays and objects.
Improved performance of indentation generation in json_encode when using JSON_PRETTY_PRINT.

sect3.title: MBString
sect3.simpara: Improved performance of mb_str_pad.

sect3.title: Phar
sect3.simpara: Reduced temporary allocations when iterating Phar directories.

sect3.title: URI
sect3.simpara: Improved performance of Uri\WhatWg\Url::parse when collecting validation errors by pre-allocating the error array.
Reduced allocations when reading IPv6/IPvFuture hosts and paths with Uri\Rfc3986\Uri.
Improved performance and memory consumption when using normalizing (non-raw) getters on already-normalized URIs with Uri\Rfc3986\Uri.

sect3.title: Zip
sect3.simpara: Improved performance of ZipArchive::addGlob and ZipArchive::addPattern by pre-allocating their returned arrays.
Avoid string copies in ZipArchive::addFromString.
